Lashes forward with the flaming lantern atop its head, sweeping broadly ahead.

name: Seed Machine Gun
description: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

name: Seed Mine
description: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

name: Seigetsu Blade
description: Selyne's exclusive skill. Fires two consecutive high-speed blades imbued with the power of moonlight.

name: Seigetsu Flash
description: Selyne's exclusive skill. Launches three high-speed swords imbued with moonlight power in succession.

name: Servant Call
description:
Eye of Cthulhu's exclusive skill. 
Summons four Servants that charge at enemies to deal damage. 
Servants disappear after taking damage or after a short time.

name: Shadow Burst
description: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

name: Shell Charge
description: Snock's exclusive skill. Withdraws into its shell to reduce damage taken while building electric charge. Once fully charged, it discharges, damaging nearby enemies. After discharging, the Attack of this Pal's Electric skills is increased for a limited time.

name: Shell Spin
description: Digtoise's exclusive skill. Moves while spinning its whole body at high speeds. Drills through enemies, dealing continuous damage.

name: Shockwave
description: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

name: Silver Steed
description: Starryon Primo's exclusive skill. Cloaks the body in radiant flames and charges toward the enemy.

name: Slime Press (Dark)
description:
Purple Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slime Press (Fire)
description:
Red Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slime Press (Grass)
description:
Green Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slime Press (Neutral)
description:
Illuminant Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slime Press (Rainbow)
description:
Rainbow Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slime Press (Water)
description:
Blue Slime's exclusive skill. 
Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

name: Slither Slam
description:
Jormuntide's exclusive skill.
Letting out a roar, it charges toward the enemy, 
twisting its water-covered body as it advances.

name: Smoke Jet
description: Gloopie's exclusive skill. Releases smoke to conceal itself, then launches a surprise headbutt from the shadows.

name: Snow Bowling
description:
Wumpo's exclusive skill.
Rolls a snowball as it moves forward, and when it grows large enough, 
it throws it to cause an explosion.

name: Snow Claw
description:
Loupmoon Cryst's exclusive skill.
Leaps forward and attacks twice with vicious claws
imbued with ice element.

name: Snow Rush
description: Elgrove Cryst's exclusive skill. Enters a wild frenzy and unleashes two consecutive Ice-element charge attacks.

name: Solar Blast
description: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

name: Somersault Scratch
description: Sekhmets exclusive skill. Scratches the enemy while performing a backward somersault to create distance.

name: Soul Drain
description:
Omascul's exclusive skill.
Suddenly appears near the enemy, firmly restraining them with its arms, 
and absorbs the HP of the restrained enemy.

name: Spark Blast
description: The user releases a lightning ball that expands outward in a forward, circular pattern.

name: Spear Thrust
description: Paladius's exclusive skill. Clads itself in holy power before charging forward with its spear. The shield in its other hand protects from attacks during the charge.

name: Spine Vine
description: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

name: Spinning Roundhouse
description: Anubis's special skill. Performs a spin kick with its strong legs, cutting down enemies over a wide area.

name: Spinning Staff
description:
Elizabee's exclusive skill.
Channels power into its staff, and unleashes it in a whirl.

name: Spirit Dash
description:
Maraith's exclusive skill.
While running slowly, it continuously launches flickering fireballs toward the enemy.

name: Spirit Fire
description: Shoots fireballs towards an enemy. The fireballs explode after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

name: Spirit Flame
description: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

name: Splash
description: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

name: Spore Burst
description: Silvance's exclusive skill. Scatters explosive spores over a wide area, then triggers a mass explosion after a set period of time.

name: Star Mine
description: Generates stars around the enemy that explode on contact. Stars also explode after some time.

name: Stone Beat
description: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

name: Stone Blast
description: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

name: Stone Cannon
description: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

name: Stone Claw
description:
Cryolinx Terra's exclusive skill.
First, it strikes with its claws, followed by a second slash, and culminates with a powerful slash using its entire body.
When swinging the claws, rocks are launched forward in a fan shape.

name: Sumo Stomp
description: Bulldosu's exclusive skill. Raises its right hind leg high and stomps the ground, creating a shockwave that strikes enemies in a fan-shaped area ahead.

name: Sword Charge
description:
Enchanted Sword's exclusive skill. 
Lunges forward to deliver a sharp thrust.

name: Tail Slash
description: Eidrolon's exclusive skill. Closes in on the enemy at high speed to deliver a cleaving swipe with its tail.

name: Tempest Blizzard
description:
Vanwyrm Cryst's exclusive skill.
Advances while exhaling cold air from its mouth.

name: Thalassonic Laser
description:
Neptilius's exclusive skill.
Rising slightly, it gathers water at its mouth,
then sweeps a high-pressure stream vertically and horizontally three times.
Fissures form at the swept locations, erupting with water.

name: Thunder Rail
description: Charge the power of lightning to the limit and fires multiple simultaneous electric shocks at the enemy.

name: Thunder Rain
description: Calls lightning that strikes an enemy after a set amount of time has passed.

name: Thunder Spear
description: Fires a high-speed lightning spear straight ahead towards the enemy.

name: Thunder Tempest
description:
Charges forward while manipulating the atmosphere 
and enveloping itself in thunderclouds.

name: Thunder Uppercut
description: ScorpionMan_Erectric's exclusive skill. Uses superconductivity to closes the distance to the enemy at high speed, then swings its pincers upward with full force.

name: Thunderslide
description:
Penking Lux's exclusive skill.
Lies on its belly while generating electric charge all around it
before sliding at enemies at high speed.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

name: Tidal Charge
description: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Slams the body into the enemy, generating a massive wave on impact.

name: Tornado Attack
description: Nitewing's exclusive skill. Generates a tornado before soaring towards its target.

name: Torrential Blast
description: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

name: Toxic Dance
description: Dandilord's exclusive skill. Performs a dance while releasing corrosive mist. The mist remains in the area for a limited time.

name: Tri-Lightning
description: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

name: Trickster Show
description: Dupin's exclusive skill. Creates two illusions to distract enemies, then launches fire birds from its top hat.

name: Trigger Happy
description: Finsider's exclusive skill. Draws twin water blasters from its mouth, firing six shots alternately left and right, then finishes by combining both blasters to unleash one powerful shot.

name: TriSpark
description: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

name: Twin Spears
description: Necromus' exclusive skill. Clads its twin spears with vicious whirlwinds and charges forward, thrusting them one after the other.

name: Umbral Surge
description: Fires a high speed ball of dark energy that spreads forward in a radial shape.

name: Upper Smash
description: Prixter's exclusive skill. Closes the distance to the enemy at high speed, then attacks decisively with its pincers.

name: Use Weapon
description: Attack with held weapon.

name: Volcanic Burst
description: Reptyro's exclusive skill. Raises its front legs before slamming them into the ground, causing volcanic eruptions under its enemies. It simultaneously bombards them with volcanic bombs from above.

name: Volcanic Fang
description:
Blazehowl's exclusive skill.
With momentum, it pounces mercilessly on the enemy 
and causes an explosion of fire at the point of impact.

name: Volcanic Rain
description: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

name: Webstrike Impact
description:
Tarantriss's exclusive skill.
Spits out a ball of thread, entangling the target it hits. 
Then, rushes at full speed to the trapped target and delivers three slashing strikes to finish it off.

name: Wholehearted Stance
description: Dogen's exclusive skill. Adopts an aiki stance. While in stance, any attack is nullified, then instantly countered with a full-force palm strike.

name: Wind Barrier
description:
A skill exclusive to the Lilikin species.
Surround yourself with a wind barrier,
Returns the blade of wind to the attacking opponent.

name: Wind Burst
description: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

name: Wind Cutter
description: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

name: Wind Edge
description: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

name: Winged Assault
description:
Cave Bat's exclusive skill. 
Using its whole body, it lunges at the enemy, bouncing off the ground or walls on impact.
